provenance.about: BO4 material constant layout per techset NAME hash (first u64 of the techset): byte offset of each GDT key in block 0 (the first 0x100 bytes) of the material constant buffer
provenance.input: docs/references/bo4/constant-layout.json (analysis 2026-10-11, see constant-layout.md) + constant-layout-additions.json (base block of techsets without a 0x81 group, remaining-keys.md section 8) + constant-layout-reveal.json (decal reveal constants verified against stock entries, material-export.md section 8) + constant-layout-shaderread.json (detail scale and standard reveal layout read from the pixel shaders, material-export.md section 9)

sources.game: name hash found in the techset's shader record 0x81 tuples (offset and size are the game's)
sources.correlation: offset found by value correlation against BO3 stock GDTs (no hash in the game data)
sources.verified: offset read from the game's own pixel shader and the values checked against Black Ops III stock GDT entries on the same techset (live capture)
sources.shaderread: offset read from the game's own pixel shader (all passes of the techset agree), no stock entry on the techset; the method reproduced the shipped entries (detail 8 of 9, reveal 9 of 11)

evidence: the shader read for exactly this techset puts layer-1 detail UVs at cb0[4].yz = +0x44/+0x48 (round4-detailscale-shader.md section 1)
the chair family reads 1 1 there (11 materials) while the weapon/equipment parts read 8 8 / 4 4 (plausible real tiling)
the user checked in the Mod Tools material editor that detailScale 1x1 is the correct look for mtl_p8_zm_off_chair_office_executive_black*, where HydraX wrote 8x8

the layer's own gbuffer pixel shader (0c1ea095cd634ecc, read paired from mc/t8_dirt_rocky_11, round5-terrain-decal-shaders.md section 7) reads softEdge = cb0[1].w, ramp = cb0[2].x, revealScale = cb0[2].yz, invert = cb0[2].w, i.e. +0x1C/+0x20/+0x24/+0x28/+0x2C

the captured buffers of the techset hold plausible values there (mc/t8_rock_pebbles_02_pom 0.1 0.5 1 1 0, mc/t8_rock_ground_smooth_02 0.5 0.5 1 1 0, mc/t8_dirt_rocky_12 0.6495 0.78 1 1 0); the live softEdge range of the flag 0x4 layers is 0.1 to 0.6495
the techset's game entries (glossRange at +0x14/+0x18) do not overlap the group
